materials.description: Every material, in order (a cell stores its place in this list).

id.description: Its id: lower case letters, digits and hyphens. Other blocks refer to it by this.

about.description: What it is and what it's for, for people and agents: one or two sentences.

ceiling.description: The colour of its underside, if darker than its top (floors and roofs): #rrggbb.

breakable.description: Whether blasts and bullets can break it. Jump pads and flag pads can't be broken.

hits.description: How many bullet hits break a cell of it off: 1 (gravel, hay) to 20.

floor.description: It's a floor: sudden death crumbles it away.

slippery.description: You slide on it, slow to get going and slow to stop (spilt oil).

rubble.description: When what's under it is blown away, it falls and lands in heaps (gravel, hay).
